scope.source_breakdown: 105 point lines from one snapshot of Should I Take The Over + Jaylon Tyson from HaterPicks, verified in ESPN roster
scope.quote_note: American book prices as displayed on public comparison pages. Some lines have moved since snapshots; selected players have separately verified 21.5 / 13.5 current comparison lines.

method: All 106 candidates screened for points line, last five average and hit rates, 10-game record when available and quoted Over/Under. Preliminary score is descriptive only: 55 x last5 hit rate + 25 x last10 hit rate + 20 x capped last5 relative deviation; it is not a probability or recommendation. Shortlist checked against injuries, minutes, opponents, H2H, live market comparison and sample-size risks.
